prompt:
도심에서 경찰차와 승용차가 추격전을 벌인다.

골목에서 긴급하게 승용차가 대로로 나오고 경찰차는 그 뒤를 따른다.

많은 차들을 피해서 달아나는 승용차는 도심을 벗어나 큰 교각을 통해 교외 도로로 진입한다. (와이드샷)

이어서 헬기도 공중에서 추격한다. (헬기와 교각 승용차가 다 같이 보이게)

승용차가 지나가자 헬기가 교각으로 추락하고 폭발하며 교각이 무너진다. 교각에 있는 차들도 같이 무너져 바다에 빠진다.

경찰차는 교각에 진입하기 직전에 간신히 멈춘다.

승용차는 유유히 교외 도로로 빠져나간다.

environment.overview: Contemporary coastal infrastructure combines utilitarian concrete architecture, dark asphalt, galvanized steel, and a charcoal-to-pale-gray palette beneath a uniformly overcast sky.
environment.location_type: Outdoor downtown streets, a sea-crossing road bridge, and a suburban coastal road.

zones.name: Alley Mouth
zones.description: A narrow asphalt alley between tall concrete buildings, blank service doors, exposed drainpipes, scuffed masonry corners, and a shallow gutter opening onto the boulevard

zones.name: Boulevard Approach
zones.description: A multilane boulevard with pale lane markings, concrete office façades, storefront windows, a signal-controlled junction, sidewalks, streetlights, and the solid near-shore bridge abutment where the roadside barriers converge toward the bridge entrance

zones.name: Sea Bridge
zones.description: A high concrete road bridge supported by substantial piers, with continuous steel barriers, regularly spaced lamp poles, expansion joints, dark seawater below, downtown towers beyond the city end, and low scrub-covered hills beyond the suburban end

zones.name: Suburban Road
zones.description: A gently curving two-lane road beyond the far bridge abutment, bordered by low guardrails, gravel shoulders, scrub grass, utility poles, scattered low concrete buildings, and rounded coastal hills

baseline.weather: dry and still beneath continuous cloud cover
baseline.lighting: soft, diffuse daylight with restrained reflections and no strong shadows.

breakdown.logline: A fleeing sedan escapes a police pursuit through crowded city streets and across a coastal bridge, surviving a pursuing helicopter’s catastrophic crash while the bridge collapses behind it and forces the police to stop.

beats.summary: A sedan bursts from an alley onto a busy boulevard with a police cruiser immediately behind it
The sedan slips through a traffic gap that closes against the police cruiser
The sedan leaves the downtown streets and commits to the bridge toward the suburbs
A helicopter joins the pursuit above the bridge, threatening the sedan from the air
The helicopter crashes into the bridge and explodes behind the sedan, which has cleared the far end
The damaged bridge collapses, carrying its remaining civilian vehicles into the sea
The police cruiser stops just short of the destroyed bridge entrance
The undamaged sedan continues alone along the suburban road

subjects.name: Fugitive Sedan
subjects.appearance: long, low charcoal sedan with a sharply sloping roof, broad rear haunches, dark windows, and plain wheels
signature_features: its unusually low roof and long wheelbase remain recognizable from every angle; narrow horizontal rear lamps provide an additional rear identifier.

subjects.name: Police Cruiser
subjects.appearance: broad, upright sedan with pale doors, dark hood and roof, squared bodywork, and a low rectangular roof lightbar
signature_features: its tall, boxy cabin and roof-mounted lightbar distinguish its silhouette from every angle.

subjects.name: Pursuit Helicopter
subjects.appearance: pale-gray compact aircraft with an egg-shaped cabin, long slender tail boom, four-bladed main rotor, and tall landing skids
signature_features: the oversized rounded cabin, thin tail, and deep skid clearance create a distinctive outline from every angle.

subjects.name: City Bus
subjects.appearance: very long rectangular vehicle with a pale upper body, charcoal lower body, high flat roof, and a continuous dark window band
signature_features: its slab-sided length and high rectangular silhouette are recognizable from every angle.

subjects.name: Delivery Van
subjects.appearance: short, pale-gray panel van with a very high roof, blunt ends, dark bumpers, and no rear side windows
signature_features: its nearly cuboid body and unusually short wheelbase identify it from every angle.

subjects.name: Family Wagon
subjects.appearance: medium-gray long-roof wagon with a nearly level roof, pale roof rails, and an extended rear cargo section
signature_features: its elongated roof and raised rails remain identifiable from every angle.

subjects.name: City Hatchback
subjects.appearance: compact charcoal hatchback with a rounded high cabin, short wheelbase, and almost no rear overhang
signature_features: its stubby, dome-like silhouette distinguishes it from every angle.

subjects.name: Work Pickup
subjects.appearance: pale-gray single-cab pickup with a dark, empty open bed, upright cab, and moderately high ground clearance
signature_features: the pronounced separation between its short cab and long open bed is readable from every angle.

spec.shot_name: Fugitive Sedan bursting onto the boulevard
spec.camera_move: short pan following the sedan’s turn
spec.backdrop: Concrete office façades and storefront windows line the opposite sidewalk; the alley opening and its drainpipes remain visible behind the turning vehicles.
spec.action: The Fugitive Sedan swings out of the alley into the boulevard beside the moving City Bus and Delivery Van, its front end leading toward the bridge entrance and its rear trailing toward the alley. The Police Cruiser follows through the alley mouth in the same direction with its roof lights flashing.
spec.transition: Hard cut to the sedan entering the traffic gap.
